تستصحبن (form X)
# تَسْتَصْحِبْنَ (tastaṣḥibna) /tas.tasˤ.ħib.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
# تُسْتَصْحَبْنَ (tustaṣḥabna) /tus.tasˤ.ħab.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
